rationale: A unanimous, minimalist reversal focused on rejecting the Fifth Circuit’s categorical no-cause-of-action rule strongly points to the Chief Justice keeping the opinion to control scope and reserve sovereign-immunity/vehicle issues for remand. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Thomas and Gorsuch (originalist/self-executing emphasis) and possibly Barrett/Kagan to clarify that the holding is not a Bivens-style implied remedy and does not resolve § 1983 exclusivity or immunity.
